rows.Name: Efficient Strikes I
rows.Description: In Prospecting, a Strike takes 0.5 seconds less and a Heavy Strike 1 second less.

rows.Name: Bulk Refining I
rows.Description: Each power core refines 1 more item than your Gathering rank allows.

rows.Name: Rich Veins I
rows.Description: In Prospecting, claiming a rich seam with Extract takes 0.5 seconds less.

rows.Name: Strip Mining
rows.Description: Gathering style, picked in the Prospecting window with one style active at a time. In Prospecting: A Strike takes 1.5 seconds less and costs 10 more Stability, but a Survey and an Extract each take 1 second more.

rows.Name: Efficient Strikes II
rows.Description: In Prospecting, a Strike takes 1 second less and a Heavy Strike 2 seconds less.

rows.Name: Bulk Refining II
rows.Description: Each power core refines 2 more items than your Gathering rank allows.

rows.Name: Core Sample
rows.Description: In Prospecting, the window shows how many seams the node still holds and whether each is a rich seam or a gem pocket, before you find them. A Heavy Strike shows a chance to shatter a gem pocket only when one is hidden there.

rows.Name: Rich Veins II
rows.Description: In Prospecting, claiming a rich seam with Extract takes 1 second less.

rows.Name: Bulk Refining III
rows.Description: Each power core refines 3 more items than your Gathering rank allows.

rows.Name: Mother Lode
rows.Description: In Prospecting, the first Strike or Heavy Strike of each node takes 50% of its usual time.

rows.Name: Fine Trowel I
rows.Description: In Search, a Dig Deeper find rolls the site's rare entries with 4 times their usual weight instead of 3.

rows.Name: Sharp Chisel I
rows.Description: In Prospecting, a Heavy Strike is 5 points less likely to shatter a gem pocket you have not surveyed (20% becomes 15%).

rows.Name: Steady Dig
rows.Description: In Search, the risk that Dig Deeper ruins a spot is 15% lower (a 30% risk becomes 26%).

rows.Name: Careful Hands
rows.Description: Gathering style, picked in the Search window with one style active at a time. In Search: A Search finds 1 point less often, and a Dig Deeper find favours the site's rare entries 3 more.

rows.Name: Keen Eye
rows.Description: In Search, a Search finds 1 point more often on every spot.

rows.Name: Sharp Chisel II
rows.Description: In Prospecting, a Heavy Strike is 10 points less likely to shatter a gem pocket you have not surveyed (20% becomes 10%).

rows.Name: Deep Scan
rows.Description: In Prospecting, a Survey reveals 1 more seam than your Gathering rank allows, up to the 3 a node holds, and reveals gem pockets before rich seams.

rows.Name: Fine Trowel II
rows.Description: In Search, a Dig Deeper find rolls the site's rare entries with 5 times their usual weight instead of 3.

rows.Name: Rich Pickings
rows.Description: In Search, a Search that finds something rolls the site's rare entries with 2 times their usual weight.

rows.Name: Jackpot
rows.Description: In Search, the first Dig Deeper find of each board rolls the site's rare entries with 7 times their usual weight instead of 3, plus what Fine Trowel and Careful Hands add.
